name: Field Notes Deck
description: Create an offline-ready executive presentation with a green field-notes canvas, crisp serif typography, aligned reference grids, and evidence-first charts. Best for publishing teams reporting results and asking clients to make a clear decision.
whatYouGet: Action-led titles and a consistent editorial layout system
Legible charts with units, periods, and target labels
Keyboard navigation and print-ready slide pages
goodFit: Client reporting for a publishing or media team
Course performance or editorial programme reviews
A recurring presentation series that needs a locked visual style
notFor: A report that needs fabricated evidence to fill gaps

faq.q: Can the deck use my exact wording?
faq.a: Yes. Identify text that must remain verbatim; the deck will preserve it and flag copy that cannot fit cleanly.

faq.q: What happens when a metric has no source?
faq.a: It is flagged for confirmation rather than presented as a verified result.

demoPrompt: /sl-field-notes-deck Create a 9-slide executive review for fictional North District Publishing, moving from quarterly readership growth through newsletter contribution to two experiments and an approval decision. Title slide: “Qualified readership grew, and the next test is ready.” Closing slide: “Approve the tests and review the results in four weeks.” Use a Sage Grid Notes style.
followUpPrompts: Shorten the deck to seven slides while preserving every approved metric.
Replace the Q4 target with the revised figure in my source notes and update all references.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
